description: Measures a logical 6x6 coincidence matrix across two entangled-pair analyzer arms. Every physical acquisition uses the standard required detector-latch guard, so a recovered latch retries only its affected window while preserving previously accepted projections.
summary: Acquire guarded two-arm polarization tomography as a logical 6x6 coincidence matrix.

linkPairIds.description: Exactly two distinct entangled-pair link identifiers, defining row and column order in the returned matrix. They must resolve to two distinct analyzer channels: channels 1 and 2 of one PA2000, or one channel on each of two separate analyzers. Each MPC320 supports only logical channel 1.

items.description: One entangled-pair link identifier resolved from network.json.

polarizationAnalyzerDeviceIds.description: Unique analyzer device identifiers resolved from the selected link arms and leased for the whole matrix. Use one two-channel PA2000 or two separate analyzer devices, for example two PA1000 or two MPC320 devices. MPC320 supports only logical channel 1; each selected channel uses the polarizer or PBS topology declared in network.json.

resourceDeviceIds.description: Exact lease union of the resolved TimeTagger, every analyzer device, and every detector-health device selected by the TimeTagger healthGuards mappings.

items.description: One device retained for the complete tomography attempt.

measurementDurationSec.description: Finite integration duration for each physical analyzer configuration, in seconds. Simultaneous readout selects 36 configurations for two polarizers, 18 for PBS/polarizer, or 9 for two PBS analyzers. Symmetrized readout uses six settings on each arm and therefore 36 configurations, preserving effective single-window counts in the aggregated matrix.

settleSec.description: Non-blocking delay after each analyzer-state change and before its finite measurement window, in seconds. The default allows the polarization analyzers to settle physically.

coincidenceWindowPs.description: AND coincidence window for every projection, in picoseconds.

useCompensatedTomoStates.description: Whether analyzer states are applied from installed or loaded compensation tables; false uses factory states and never requires a compensation table.

backgroundCountRateHz.description: Uniform coincidence background rate applied to every physical pair when backgroundObservation is null; must be zero when a per-pair background observation is supplied.

backgroundObservation.description: Optional separately acquired MeasureLinkBackgroundCoincidences observation.background export, containing measurementKind=coincidences and observation with timeTaggerDeviceId, coincidenceWindowPs, measurementDurationSec and countsByPair. Must cover every topology-resolved detector pair with finite non-negative counts on the same TimeTagger and coincidence window. Each physical reading is corrected before symmetrized aggregation. Null selects the uniform backgroundCountRateHz; compensation backgrounds are not imported automatically.

pbsReadout.description: Independent tomography readout choice: simultaneous acquires H/D/R on each PBS; symmetrized acquires H/V/D/A/R/L and averages repeated logical projections after detector-pair background correction. Polarizers always acquire six settings. The result is always a 6x6 matrix with counts normalized to one measurementDurationSec window, plus all physical readings and integration times.

clear.description: Must be true so an invalid latch-guarded child window can be retried as a fresh integration.

latchGuard.description: Required detector-latch policy for every physical child coincidence window. The TimeTagger healthGuards topology selects the health devices and channel mappings; only the affected window is retried after recovery.

mode.description: This finite tomography always requires detector-latch protection.

maxWindowRetries.description: Maximum immediate retries of one recovered latch-invalid physical acquisition window.

dwdmChannelByLink.description: Optional per-link DWDM channel overrides for analyzer wavelength preparation.

defaultDwdmChannel.description: Optional fallback DWDM channel when a selected link omits one in network.json.

useCompensatedTomoStatesByLink.description: Optional exact map of both linkIds to boolean table policies. A nonempty map overrides useCompensatedTomoStates, allowing a factory reference and compensated target without changing either policy implicitly.

link.characterization.observation.entang.description: Accepted logical 6x6 raw and background-corrected coincidence matrices, including the topology-derived physical configuration count, projection provenance, and detector-health attempt history.
